entries.title: Superiority object and effect-size threshold change
entries.fact: Object: B2-fav / Peace-fav (pre-verdict H1) -> rigorous set R = {B1, B4, B4-bal, B2-rect, B3-rect, Peace-rect, Hait-SW, Molitor-WoR, QFC-pool}. entries.title: r4_g_eps_select read evaluation-half aggregate truth

(2) Aggregate truth: yes, guard_tables.json CR9|eval holds 15 rows with J_star, second_gap, eps_set_size, min_trivial_regret; the counts n_nontrivial_eval (CR9: 15 at every eps in {0.001, 0.0015, 0.002, 0.003}; HR8: 10/5/5/5) entered the eligibility rule via guard_ok.
